name: basalt-theme
description: Build tooling for the Basalt WordPress theme. The theme itself ships without dependencies.

scripts.dev:seed: docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml exec -T cli sh /seed/seed.sh
scripts.dev:cli: docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml exec -T cli wp
scripts.dev:log: docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml exec -T cli sh -c "cat /var/www/html/wp-content/debug.log 2>/dev/null || echo (clean)"
